title: Manila logs 2,692 flu-like cases this year amid 8% national rise

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila recorded nine new cases of influenza-like illness (ILI) on Monday, Oct. 26, bringing the city’s total to 2,692 since the start of the year, amid a reported increase in flu-like illnesses nationwide. In an interview with Super Radyo dzBB, Health Secretary Edwin Mercado said the DOH recorded 11,137 ILI cases in its latest reporting period, an 8% increase from the 10,278 cases recorded from Sept. 3 to 16. Mercado said the increase coincided with cooler weather and gatherings that can spread respiratory infections.
